title: Telemetry Coverage Gaps
description: SigNoz native dashboard highlighting silent services and telemetry coverage drops

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT service, last_seen_at, dateDiff('minute', last_seen_at, NOW()) AS silent_minutes FROM telemetry_health.coverage_signal WHERE last_seen_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE ORDER BY silent_minutes DESC

clickhouse_sql.name: B
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfMinute(last_seen_at) AS time, count(DISTINCT service) AS active_services FROM telemetry_health.coverage_signal WHERE last_seen_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
